claims: Allbirds (BIRD) stock closed up over 500% on April 15, 2026.
Allbirds announced a pivot from sustainable footwear to AI computing.
Allbirds is rebranding from Allbirds to NewBird AI.
Allbirds' original footwear intellectual property and assets were sold to American Exchange Group for $39 million.
Allbirds' pivot was fueled by $50M in new funding.
Allbirds is shifting to AI compute infrastructure.
Allbirds is focusing on offering GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) and cloud services.
Allbirds is transitioning from a public benefit corporation to a conventional corporation.
Allbirds was valued at over $4 billion upon its 2021 IPO.
